backup.production_rule: s111 rev 2 (Lloyd 2026-11-08: per-night utility figures were wrong; contract docs/s111/contracts-rev2.md). public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date) redefined: the utility block is per day between meter readings (kwh_per_day, m3_per_day, nights_booked = metrics sold_nights, nights_in_month, last_reading, per_stay, per_month; kwh_per_night, m3_per_night, nights_month removed) and admin.target is added. New table public.kpi_targets (RLS on, no client grants) and new function public.kpi_target_set_v1(uuid,numeric) (manage_operations). Apply after the s110 release and together with the s111 staff app 3.4.27. restore_point is the backup used for the rehearsal; the orchestrator re-stamps both fields on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase expand: one new table, one new write function, one read function redefined; nothing dropped or deleted. Removing three utility keys is a read-model change: the 3.4.25 app shows blanks for them, so it ships with 3.4.27.

forward_verification.name: md5_kpi_tab_v1
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '156e8186cfd9aea5ac0cc2f4afb1275d' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: md5_kpi_target_set_v1
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '7710b844d25e1c09c68ca968f67f464b' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_target_set_v1(uuid,numeric)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_has_rev2_utility
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%kwh_per_day%' and prosrc like '%nights_booked%' and prosrc like '%kpi_targets%' and prosrc not like '%kwh_per_night%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_keeps_finance_gate
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%read_finance%' and prosrc like '%if v_fin then%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: functions_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure, 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.kpi_target_set_v1(uuid,numeric)'::regprocedure, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.kpi_target_set_v1(uuid,numeric)'::regprocedure, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.kpi_target_set_v1(uuid,numeric)'::regprocedure, 'execute')

forward_verification.name: functions_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""']) and count(*) = 2 from pg_proc where oid in ('public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure, 'public.kpi_target_set_v1(uuid,numeric)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: kpi_targets_locked
forward_verification.query: select c.relrowsecurity and not has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.kpi_targets', 'select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.kpi_targets', 'select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.kpi_targets', 'insert') from pg_class c where c.oid = 'public.kpi_targets'::regclass

rollback.safe_until: Always: the script puts the s110 body of kpi_tab_v1 back exactly and drops kpi_target_set_v1 and kpi_targets (an owner-set target is lost). Roll the staff app back with it.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
